steps.task: Run one discovery call with each simulated founder, in parallel: founder-priya, founder-tomas, founder-aisha, founder-ben.
steps.notes: Four calls run in parallel, 8 questions each, relayed verbatim by the Chief of Staff; each ended with CALL COMPLETE. A stray extra founder-aisha instance was spawned by mistake with the text 'placeholder'; its reply was ignored and never relayed, so it is not part of any transcript. Revision 1 (grader): each discovery agent also wrote its needs brief to the standard location briefs/<slug>.md and its transcript to calls/<slug>.md, byte-identical to the calls/<slug>/ originals.

steps.task: Send linear-scout to read every issue in /mnt/session/uploads/linear/tickets.json (all time).
steps.notes: 5 of 5 issues read (team FFD, all time), giving 5 evidence items.
1 page read, giving 6 evidence items: 3 founder quotes, 1 note-taker paraphrase, 2 mentor observations.

steps.task: Send the miner everything; it writes /mnt/session/outputs/room-report.md in EVAL mode.
steps.notes: Ranked 10 clusters across 10 distinct founders. The miner checked all 33 quotes by script as exact substrings of the evidence. The pain library was updated at /mnt/memory/room-miner-pain-library/. Revision 1 (grader): the miner moved the blocker tally by CMA primitive to the end of room-report.md, cited briefs/<slug>.md, and added a needs_briefs map to clusters.json. Quotes, counts and rankings are unchanged.

steps.task: Send the data-analyst the miner's output; it builds data/room.db, data/metrics.json and /mnt/session/outputs/dashboard.html.
steps.notes: room.db has 9 tables. metrics.json includes a verification block. The dashboard is self-contained with 0 external URLs. The analyst found no mismatches against room-report.md or clusters.json. Revision 1: rebuilt with brief_path set to briefs/<slug>.md, and the checks re-run against the revised report with 0 mismatches.

steps.task: Keep run-manifest.json current for every step and append this run's entry to the run journal.
steps.notes: Manifest updated after each step. Journal entry appended. The system prompt names /mnt/memory/run-journal/, but the mounted store is /mnt/memory/room-miner-run-journal/.
